questions.question: A SOC analyst needs to correlate firewall, VPN and domain controller logs to detect a brute-force attack across systems. Which tool BEST supports this?
questions.explanation: A SIEM aggregates logs from many sources and correlates related events into a single alert, which is exactly what cross-system detection requires.
incorrectAnswerExplanations: Scanners find vulnerabilities; they do not correlate logs.
A protocol analyzer captures packets on one segment.
An HSM stores and uses cryptographic keys.
questions.examClue: Correlate events from many log sources = SIEM.

questions.question: Which TWO are characteristics of symmetric encryption?
choices: A single shared key encrypts and decrypts
It is well suited to encrypting large amounts of data
It relies on a public/private key pair
questions.explanation: Symmetric algorithms such as AES use one shared key and are fast, which makes them ideal for bulk data.
